title: Data S1: telomere repeat diversity in Zygnematophyceae, the closest algal relatives of land plants
description: Supporting data and analysis scripts for K. K. Sahu, 'Telomere repeat diversity in Zygnematophyceae, the closest algal relatives of land plants: evidence from long and short reads' (submitted to Journal of Phycology). Per-strain telomeric unit tables, telomerase RNA sequences, covariance model and alignments, TERT protein models, 18S rRNA alignment and trees, and analysis scripts. All input data are public; accessions are listed in the article's Table 1, Table S1 and Table S2.
